description: Twelve tracks of sixteen steps, all clocked and addressed together, each track with a gate output and a trigger output

params.text: Switches that step on or off for that track
Sets how many of the sixteen steps are played, from 1 to 16; the small green lights below the step numbers show the length in use
Holds that track's gate and trigger outputs at 0V while it is on, leaving the sequence running
Picks one of nine ways through the sequence: forward, pendulum, reverse, random, those four again as one-shots that stop at the end of a single pass, and voltage addressed
In the voltage addressed mode, picks the step to play, read at the start of each clock pulse; with a cable in the address CV input it attenuates that voltage instead

inputs.text: A gate above 2V lets the sequencer run and a level below 0.1V pauses it, play resuming at the next clock; with nothing patched the sequencer runs
Each rising edge above 2V moves the sequencer on one step, and the time it stays high sets the length of the trigger pulses
A rising edge above 2V restarts the sequence at step one on the next clock, or at once if it lands within 100uS of a clock edge; it is ignored in the random and voltage addressed modes
Sets how many steps are played, 0V giving one step and 10V all sixteen, and disables the LENGTH knob while patched
Picks the way through the sequence and disables the DIR. knob: below 1V forward, then pendulum, reverse and random a volt apart, the same four as one-shots from 4V, voltage addressed from 8V
In the voltage addressed mode, picks the step to play, 10V always reaching the last step whatever the length; the ADDR knob then attenuates this voltage

outputs.text: Holds at 10V for the whole of any step switched on for that track, so two steps on in a row give one unbroken gate
Pulses to 10V on any step switched on for that track, for as long as the clock input is high
Goes to 10V at the end of a one-shot pass and stays there until a reset arrives

menu: Channel 1 through to Channel 12 — each leads to Initialize and Randomize for that track, and to the patterns On the One, On the Two, On the Three, On the Four, Odds, Evens and The lot

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
